casing_airframe_high_rebound_tpu.structural_purpose: Flexible protective auxetic airframe body. Sliced at a dense 0.16mm layer boundary track to maximize elastic toolpath welding density, entirely avoiding FDM micro-gaps.

snap_rails_carbon_fiber_nylon.structural_purpose: Pre-tensioned anti-creep internal rail structures. Sliced in Carbon-Fiber Nylon (PA-CF) at 100% solid concentric density to mirror the near-perfect 97% elastic recovery rating of flea resilin rubber, pulling the outer TPU frame back to factory specifications instantly when a device is extracted.
